applyTo: "**/*Tests.cs"

# Testing Instructions

- Use xUnit.
- Follow Arrange-Act-Assert.
- Mock external dependencies.
- Include tests for error scenarios.

## Test Case Generation

Ask Copilot to generate:

- Happy path scenarios
- Negative scenarios
- Edge cases
- Boundary conditions

## Defect Analysis

Ask Copilot to:

- Suggest root causes
- Recommend regression tests
- Identify risk areas
